title: Initcode/Code-Injection Target Hosts
description: General approach for targets that execute user-submitted code
detail: Characteristic: the platform runs scripts/initial code you submit. Approach: 1) In the submitted code, directly import os/subprocess to read environment variables and files (sensitive artifacts are often in env or the working directory). 2) When the sandbox blocks imports: read globals via f-strings/format strings, bypass with __import__, or use the builtins chain. 3) Network callback (if outbound access is available): use curl to exfiltrate to your listener. 4) Check crontabs/history/neighboring processes for the execution identity. Note: probe which imports are available before writing the exploit.
